evidence: Complex conjugation/transposition in measure implements |q^dagger G k|^2 correctly; the null computation is 0.01 ||G q||^2.
Fixed positive ridge makes each supported Gram matrix positive definite; token effects plus null sum to identity.
Attention accepts features/masks only. Vocab and label-map fitting uses training records only; selection uses validation macro-F1.
The fixed trace example is selected before training. epoch_order places training index zero first for actual update0.
The source hashes for the 28 declared source-contract files in the bounded staging copy match the packet.

observations: No mismatch with the bounded equations was found.
144 is a nominal parameter count. Common-unitary gauge freedom and control-specific redundant parameters prevent an effective-capacity equivalence claim.
The computation has an exact classical expression; no novelty, quantum advantage or efficacy conclusion follows from implementation fidelity.
This review covers the synthetic CPU canary. It does not certify full-data execution or collaborator handoff.

evidence: Each active condition rebuilds and loads the same seed-specific warmup best model; all active modes reseed to seed+1000 and construct the same Q/K parameter layout.
The classifier and logical update schedule are shared across all conditions; the disabled condition intentionally lacks the additional 144 kernel parameters.
Fidelity omits the joint Gram by construction; diagonal removes key coherences before summation; mismatch rotates only valid keys and keeps values at their original positions.
Training uses sum CE divided by logical batch count across microbatches, preserving the logical objective.
limits: These controls isolate the stated mechanisms but are not an effective-capacity matched proof of quantum-specific benefit.

evidence: Backward uses the inverse-root Loewner divided difference -1/(sqrt(a)*sqrt(b)*(sqrt(a)+sqrt(b))), which remains finite at repeated positive eigenvalues and avoids eigenvector-gap divisions.
Hermitian symmetrization is applied to both the input and adjoint gradient; the implementation is the correct self-adjoint Frechet derivative for this function.
Circuit/state/Gram arithmetic is complex128/float64; context is computed in probability precision and then cast to base value dtype.
Training rejects nonfinite loss and gradients. Authored tests cover repeated/unequal spectra, analytical duplicate-key/null cases, gradient equivalence and microbatch accumulation.
limits: Only first derivatives are supported, explicitly enforced with once_differentiable; current Adam training needs only these.
CUDA behavior and performance remain unverified.
The supplied focused-test outcome is host evidence, not a test run by this reviewer.

evidence: The public parent launches serial workers through the same interpreter and entry path, with repository cwd and explicit single-thread environment. Worker profile and device are loaded and validated from the manifest; their omission from child argv is intentional and safe.
Review/source/config/data/environment checks precede computation. The public path rejects raw output under the checkout and exposes no full-data profile.
Each completed optimizer batch saves model, Adam, RNG, next-update/index cursor, best-model state and validation cursor.
If interruption occurs between a final batch commit and validation selection, run detects the unselected epoch boundary and evaluates validation before further training.
An uncommitted batch can be replayed from the last committed deterministic state; completed workers are verified before being skipped.
Terminal final/best trace capture does not overwrite the committed final optimizer checkpoint with the selected best model.
remaining_validation: Run the authored real-parent CPU canary and exact-resume/export-failure retry test after the host installs this exact-source review.

The existing lifecycle test exercises a graceful mid-epoch pause. Hard process termination and epoch-boundary interruption are supported by static ordering analysis but not yet demonstrated by this packet.
lifecycle_correctness.platform_limit: exclusive uses fcntl and atomic_json/syncdir use POSIX directory fsync; execute the canary on the intended POSIX server. Native Windows execution is unsupported.

evidence: Actual update0 captures the first selected record's forward intermediates before optimizer.step, the full logical-batch accumulated gradient/loss, the pre-step parameter vector and the actual post-step vector; the scope of batch loss/gradient is disclosed.
Initial/best/final snapshots cover the same chosen record in every split, zero gradients before/after replay and never step the optimizer.

Independent NumPy replay checks circuit gates, density/effects, spectrum, Born/null probabilities and context. Inventory, arbitrary-coordinate reader, file hashes, full shapes and finite values are checked.
Two checkpoint generations are retained behind an atomic hashed pointer. Completion verifies required artifact inventory, final cursor/identity and full traces; modified checkpoint bytes fail closed.
Export constructs only summary.json, manifest.json, trace_validation.json and receipt.json. No sentences, raw selected indexes, model state or value arrays are copied.

Export validates the completed immutable source, creates a temporary sibling directory, publishes by rename and removes temporary files on injected failure. Existing matching exports are checked and returned without training.
limits: The trace validator checks update-delta arithmetic and producer lineage, but does not independently recompute Adam from a captured whole minibatch; the source is the basis for actual-update attribution.
Trace array writes use close-and-rename without explicit fsync of every array. Process-interruption recovery is plausible; machine/power-loss durability of all trace arrays is not certified.
Injected export failure cleanup, immutable retry and exact resumed optimizer/RNG equality still require the pending real-parent test.

permitted_next_stage: Bounded synthetic CPU canary through the real parent on POSIX, including the authored exact-resume and injected-export-failure/retry checks. This is not permission for full-data execution.

Nominal capacity, novelty, efficacy and quantum attribution remain unproved.
